title: GTA6 Marketing Finally Starts in London with First Sighting
description: GTA6 marketing has reportedly kicked off in London, with a Reddit user spotting the first promotional material near Westfield Stratford.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Marketing Finally Starts in London with First Sighting

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of Rockstar Games' *Grand Theft Auto VI*, every minor development is heavily scrutinized by fans worldwide. Recently, a post on the popular Reddit community r/GTA6 has sparked widespread excitement, suggesting that the offline marketing campaign for *GTA6* may have finally kicked off in London, United Kingdom.

### The First Apparent Ad Spotted in Stratford

According to a submission by Reddit user /u/HyperFlie, the promotional material was discovered on the bridge connecting the trains to Westfield Stratford in London. Based on the user's current observations, this appears to be the only location where such a display has been spotted so far. The poster expressed hope that more promotional sites will start popping up across the city in the near future.

It is important to note that this information originates from a community member and should be categorized as an unconfirmed rumor, as Rockstar Games has not issued any official statement or confirmation regarding the sighting yet. Nonetheless, for a community starved of official updates, even localized sightings like this quickly become major talking points.

### A Traditional Rockstar Marketing Playbook

Looking back at Rockstar Games' historical marketing campaigns for titles like *GTA V* and *Red Dead Redemption 2*, massive outdoor billboard campaigns, building wraps, and transit station takeovers have always been a staple of their promotional strategy. If physical advertisements are indeed rolling out in a major metropolis like London, it could signal the beginning of a broader, global marketing rollout.

For now, players and industry watchers alike will be keeping a close eye on London and other major global cities to see if additional advertisements emerge in the coming days.

## Editor's Take

While this sighting comes directly from a community source and remains an unconfirmed rumor, the eventual start of physical marketing is an inevitable milestone for *GTA6*. If accurate, it marks the exciting early pulse of Rockstar's promotional machine. We will keep monitoring for any official confirmations.
